study type: Prospective cohort study (biomarker discovery and validation)
cohort: Maternal plasma samples were collected from a discovery cohort of 29 women (16 subsequently delivered normally grown babies and 13 delivered SGA) selected from 511 women, and validated in an independent cohort of 95 women (SGA n=12, Control n=83).
finding: Differential expression of hsa-miR-374a-5p and hsa-let-7d-5p in maternal plasma at 12-14+6 weeks gestation showed potential as biomarkers for early prediction of SGA births.
birth_weight: SGA defined as birthweight <10th centile; selected SGA cases had birthweight <5th centile.
gest_age: SGA refers to 'small for gestational age'; maternal plasma samples were collected at 12-14+6 weeks gestation.
